about_short_description.short_description: Anoria specializes in window and floor coverings, blinds, curtains, mural paper, and wallpaper.

product.name: Blinds
product.description: Window coverings including roller, double roller, venetian, vertical, honeycell, pleated, panel truck, roman shade, and skylight blinds for light control and privacy.

product.name: Floor Coverings
product.description: Various floor covering options including vinyl, linoleum, laminate, parquet, carpet tiles, rolls, and artificial grass for residential and commercial use.

product.name: Curtains
product.description: Fabric window treatments designed to provide privacy, light control, and decorative enhancement for interiors.

product.name: Wallpaper and Mural Paper
product.description: Decorative wall coverings including wallpaper and mural paper to transform interior spaces with various designs and textures.

product.name: Rugs and Carpets
product.description: A selection of rugs and carpets in various materials, colors, and patterns for residential and commercial flooring needs.

product.name: Doormats
product.description: Entrance mats designed for durability and resistance, suitable for buildings and businesses, with customization options.
